description: PrimeVue Checkbox component wrapped for use with FormManager.
_comment: Validation expects properties within a 'props' object.

props.description: Container for Checkbox wrapper props, PrimeVue Checkbox props, and HTML attributes.

children.description: Checkbox wrapper does not typically accept children.

implementationNotes: Includes props for the wrapper (inputId, header) and props passed to PrimeVue Checkbox via $attrs.
Added `label` to structuralKeys and removed from props to support older structures.
Validation for 'value' being required when binary=false is handled by component logic.
